how.title: How it works
how.source: Where essential expenses come from. We add up everything you logged in categories marked as essential, including card purchases and debt installments. We use the average of the last 3 closed months. If you’re just getting started, you’ll see an estimate based on the current month, and you can enter the amount if you prefer.
how.mark: How to mark a category as essential. In Categories, edit the category and check “This is an essential expense”. From then on, expenses in that category count toward the calculation.
how.money: How money gets into the emergency fund. The emergency fund isn’t a new account: it adds up the balance of the accounts you select here. If the balance goes up or down, the fund follows.

activation.title: Before you start
activation.text: Ask about your family’s money, simulate a decision and get the next steps for your goals, trips and retirement.
activation.uses: Your question and, when it needs them, your transactions, income, emergency fund, debts, investments, goals, trips and calendar. Descriptions are sent exactly as they appear on your statement. Overnight, it uses the same data to prepare tips on each screen and tidy up your transaction categories.
activation.leavesOut: Names, email addresses, CPF (Brazilian taxpayer ID) and passwords. It doesn’t access any bank and doesn’t move money.
